description: Byte-exact historical M9 K/L/M PACK walker sources; GITP9PWK production entrypoint retained.

files.GITP9KWK.EXEC:
/* M9K bounded ordinary PACK walker using streaming zlib output. */
parse upper arg command extra
if command \= 'WALK' | extra \= '' then do
   say 'Usage: GITP9KWK WALK'
   exit 4
end
address command
call readhex 0,12
if result = 'ERROR' then exit 8
hdr = result
if substr(hdr,1,8) \= '5041434B' then do
   say 'GITP9KWK: bad PACK signature'
   exit 8
end
version = x2d(substr(hdr,9,8))
objects = x2d(substr(hdr,17,8))
if version \= 2 then exit 8
pos = 12
do entry = 1 to objects
   entrypos = pos
   call readbyte pos
   if result = 'ERROR' then exit 8
   b = result
   pos = pos + 1
   type = (b % 16) // 8
   size = b // 16
   shift = 4
   more = b >= 128
   do while more
      call readbyte pos
      if result = 'ERROR' then exit 8
      b = result
      pos = pos + 1
      size = size + (b // 128) * (2 ** shift)
      shift = shift + 7
      more = b >= 128
   end
   if type \= 3 then do
      say 'GITP9KWK: M9K supports ordinary blobs only'
      exit 8
   end
   'EXEC GITPZBUF TOOBUF' pos
   if rc \= 0 then exit rc
   if queued() < 2 then exit 8
   parse pull used
   parse pull outlen
   if outlen \= size then do
      say 'GITP9KWK: inflated size mismatch'
      exit 8
   end
   'EXEC GITBOID BLOB' outlen
   if rc \= 0 | queued() < 1 then exit 8
   parse pull oid
   say 'ENTRY' entry 'POSITION' entrypos 'TYPE BLOB SIZE' size
   say 'OBJECT BYTES' outlen
   say 'OBJECT OID' oid
   pos = pos + used
end
say 'PACK VERSION' version
say 'PACK OBJECTS' objects
say 'PACK DATA END' pos
exit 0
readbyte:
   parse arg offset
   call readhex offset,1
   if result = 'ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
   return x2d(result)
readhex:
   parse arg offset,count
   'EXEC GITPBUF READSTACK' offset count
   if rc \= 0 | queued() < 1 then return 'ERROR'
   parse pull h
   if length(h) \= count*2 then return 'ERROR'
   return translate(h)
files.GITP9LWK.EXEC:
/* M9L bounded OFS_DELTA PACK walker, isolated from M9K. */
parse upper arg command extra
if command \= 'WALK' | extra \= '' then exit 4
address command
call readhex 0,12
if result='ERROR' then exit 8
hdr=result
if substr(hdr,1,8)\='5041434B' then exit 8
version=x2d(substr(hdr,9,8)); objects=x2d(substr(hdr,17,8))
if version\=2 then exit 8
pos=12
basepos=-1
do entry=1 to objects
 entrypos=pos
 call readbyte pos
 if result='ERROR' then exit 8
 b=result; pos=pos+1
 type=(b%16)//8
 size=b//16; shift=4; more=b>=128
 do while more
  call readbyte pos
  if result='ERROR' then exit 8
  b=result; pos=pos+1
  size=size+(b//128)*(2**shift)
  shift=shift+7; more=b>=128
 end
 if type=3 then do
  'EXEC GITPZBUF TOOBUF' pos
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull used
  parse pull outlen
  if outlen\=size then exit 8
  call savebase outlen
  if result\='OK' then exit 8
  basepos=entrypos
  'EXEC GITBOID BLOB' outlen
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull oid
  say 'ENTRY' entry 'POSITION' entrypos 'TYPE BLOB SIZE' size
  say 'OBJECT OID' oid
  pos=pos+used
 end
 else if type=6 then do
  c=0
  do forever
   call readbyte pos
   if result='ERROR' then exit 8
   b=result; pos=pos+1
   if c=0 then dist=b//128
   else dist=((dist+1)*128)+(b//128)
   c=c+1
   if b<128 then leave
  end
  want=entrypos-dist
  if want\=basepos then do
   say 'GITP9LWK: OFS base not available'
   exit 8
  end
  'EXEC GITPZBUF TOOBUF' pos
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull used
  parse pull dlen
  /* PACK size on a delta entry is delta-program size. */
  if dlen\=size then do
   say 'GITP9LWK: inflated delta size mismatch'
   exit 8
  end
  'EXEC GITBDAPP APPLY'
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull outlen
  call installout outlen
  if result\='OK' then exit 8
  'EXEC GITBOID BLOB' outlen
  if rc\=0 then exit rc
  parse pull oid
  say 'ENTRY' entry 'POSITION' entrypos 'TYPE OFS SIZE' size
  say 'BASE POSITION' want
  say 'OBJECT BYTES' outlen
  say 'OBJECT OID' oid
  pos=pos+used
 end
 else exit 8
end
say 'PACK VERSION' version
say 'PACK OBJECTS' objects
say 'PACK DATA END' pos
exit 0
savebase:
 parse arg n
 'ERASE GITBASE DATA A'
 off=0
 do while off<n
  take=n-off
  if take>64 then take=64
  'EXEC GITOBUF READSTACK' off take
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  parse pull h
  r.1=h; r.0=1
  'EXECIO 1 DISKW GITBASE DATA A 0 (STEM R. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
  off=off+take
 end
 m.1='META' n '- 1'; m.0=1
 'EXECIO 1 DISKW GITBMETA DATA A 1 (STEM M. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'
installout:
 parse arg n
 'EXEC GITOBUF INIT'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 drop r.
 'EXECIO * DISKR GITOUT DATA A 1 (STEM R. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 do i=1 to r.0
  'EXEC GITOBUF APPEND' strip(r.i)
  if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 end
 'EXEC GITOBUF FINAL'
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 return 'OK'
readbyte:
 parse arg off
 call readhex off,1
 if result='ERROR' then return 'ERROR'
 return x2d(result)
readhex:
 parse arg off,n
 'EXEC GITPBUF READSTACK' off n
 if rc\=0 then return 'ERROR'
 parse pull h
 if length(h)\=n*2 then return 'ERROR'
 return translate(h)
